name: smoke-1x
baseline: swarm-desk Elixir native loop, hard-final.json (sonnet5-full 100%, haiku45-full 88% hidden pass on bench/hard)

seats.grade_command: mkdir -p test/accept && cp "$FLEET_ROOT"/bench/hard/accept/catalog-search.test.ts "$FLEET_ROOT"/bench/hard/accept/fixtures.ts test/accept/ && node --test --test-reporter=dot test/accept/catalog-search.test.ts; e=$?; rm -rf test/accept; exit $e

mkdir -p test/accept && cp "$FLEET_ROOT"/bench/hard/accept/catalog-search.test.ts "$FLEET_ROOT"/bench/hard/accept/fixtures.ts test/accept/ && node --test --test-reporter=dot test/accept/catalog-search.test.ts; e=$?; rm -rf test/accept; exit $e

mkdir -p test/accept && cp "$FLEET_ROOT"/bench/hard/accept/report-currency-mix.test.ts "$FLEET_ROOT"/bench/hard/accept/fixtures.ts test/accept/ && node --test --test-reporter=dot test/accept/report-currency-mix.test.ts; e=$?; rm -rf test/accept; exit $e

seats.test_command: cd "${CF_BUILD_BENCH:?set CF_BUILD_BENCH}" && npx tsx src/cli.ts gate --task kv-crud --candidate "$OLDPWD/src" --run-tests 2>&1 | tail -25
seats.grade_command: cd "${CF_BUILD_BENCH:?set CF_BUILD_BENCH}" && npx tsx src/cli.ts gate --task kv-crud --candidate "$OLDPWD/src" --run-tests --json 2>&1 | tail -8 | grep -q '"pass":true' && echo PASS || { echo FAIL; exit 1; }
